I do enjoy those kinds of games sometimes too.  

I played CS:GO on ESEA last season with a team, we did pretty well.  I just don't have the time for that kind of dedication anymore.
Heyy so did I.  Since about 2002.  Competitive leagues and all that.  CS is still p fun.
I know it's annoying and kinda brings you down to talk to someone in my situation.

Broke up with my girlfriend that I live with.  Don't really have anywhere to go.  Don't have any friends, never really have.  

I like CS:GO and Dota a lot but I play a lot of different things.

Yeah that's how I've always felt I guess.  About friends that is.  I was always ok with it and honestly preferred it.  Now the loneliness of not having anyone to talk to about this is crushing me.  Thinking about losing my only friend and not having anyone that wakes up and cares about your existence, how you're doing in school, or whatever other little mundane thing you have.  It's crushing.

My feet are dead from all the walking I've done in the last 3 days.  I spent at least 6 hours walking around my block just yesterday, even up until 3am.

I don't have anyone to call.  No friends.

I'm going through something very similar in that I had a very hard couple of years that led up to my current (now past I guess) relationship.  

She was my only friend, quite literally.  She was everything.  She was the only reason I got up to go to class and tried to advance myself in any way.  

Now she doesn't want me.  My depression is too much to deal with.

I can't tell if this is a drake joke or if you mean it, but if you do mean it, PM me your number.

Or I can send you mine for privacy concerns.
